name: pi-tool-distill
description: Pi extension for recoverable semantic tool-result compression.
author: pro-vi

scripts.smoke-test: agent_dir=$(mktemp -d) && PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$agent_dir pi --no-extensions --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-themes --no-context-files -e ./src/index.ts -p '/distill help' && PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$agent_dir pi --no-extensions --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-themes --no-context-files -e ./src/index.ts -p '/distill status' && PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=$agent_dir pi --no-extensions --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-themes --no-context-files -e ./src/index.ts -p '/distill policy list'; status=$?; rm -rf $agent_dir; exit $status
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke-test
